requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for a polished Japanese fantasy side-scrolling action game. Use the attached reference image only as the identity/costume/sword design reference for Eula from Genshin Impact: adult tall elegant woman, short icy pale-blue layered hair, violet eyes, dark navy black bodysuit, white and blue asymmetric sleeves, black thigh-high armored high-heel boots, short blue-white split cape with icy heraldic shapes, silver ornaments, ONE long broad blue-silver CLAYMORE. Preserve her recognizable original character design. Clean detailed anime cel-shaded painted sprites, crisp dark contours readable at small gameplay scale, no painterly blurry edges. Fixed near-profile side view facing RIGHT with a small 3/4 view of face; camera exactly horizontal at waist level, NO overhead view and NO perspective foreshortening. Consistent anatomy, body proportions, head size, sword length, costume, camera and lighting in every frame. Character motion must be articulated different poses, not copies shifted or rotated. Every frame full body including all hair, cape, feet and entire sword. TRUE transparent alpha background with no floor, shadows, checkerboard painted into image, grid lines, labels, numbers, text, watermarks, scenery, floating aura or fog. Use equal invisible grid cells, generous transparent gutters on all edges, no overlap between cells. Isolate each frame, character root centered horizontally in each cell; use maximum clean detail without cropping. Create exactly FOUR consecutive idle breathing animation frames in a 2 columns x 2 rows atlas, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom. Square canvas, each invisible cell square. Same standing full body scale (head-to-heel about 70% cell height) and feet baseline at 86% cell height in every cell. Elegant poised dancer-like claymore guard, body and face towards right, weight mainly on rear left leg, front right foot half-step forward, broad sword held in BOTH HANDS with blade angled down-forward to the right, sword not touching floor. Frame 1 neutral exhale relaxed shoulders cape settled; frame 2 slight inhale torso rises, elbows lift just slightly, cape edges lag; frame 3 breath peak small shoulder and chest opening with tiny weight shift, hair tips lag; frame 4 returns gently toward frame 1 with cape settling, seamless loop. This must remain a subtle four-frame coherent idle breathing cycle, not four unrelated hero poses. Preserve the same camera and leg placement between frames.

requests.repairPrompt: Edit the attached existing Eula RUN SPRITE ATLAS only. Preserve EXACTLY the current eight running poses, sequence, character identity, face, costume, claymore design, lighting and art quality. Required TECHNICAL LAYOUT REPAIR: still FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal square invisible cells, landscape 2:1. Shrink each of the eight entire character+sword+cape silhouettes to 78% of current size within its own cell, preserve exact original proportions, and recenter the whole silhouette in each cell with at least 10% cell-width clear transparent gutter on LEFT AND RIGHT, plus 8% top and bottom. In frames 4 and 8 restore the complete front boot toe that touched canvas edge; frames 1 and 5 front boots must NOT enter the next cell. Every complete sword and boot is visible and no limb is cropped. Uniform standing-anatomy scale remains identical across eight frames; do not independently auto-fit crouches. Clean matte extraction: remove ALL detached blue/cyan speckles, luminous haze, outlines and compression speckles in background while retaining actual blue costume and sword. Hard clean anime silhouette with antialiased edge, outside pixels fully transparent alpha. No blue aura, no glow, no drawn checkerboard, no extra motion effects. Do NOT add a ground or shadows, text, labels, or visible grid. This is not a new pose design request; fix crop/gutters/background cleanliness only.
